meta.name: caveman-help
meta.description: Quick-reference card for all caveman modes, skills, and commands. One-shot display, not a persistent mode. Trigger: /caveman-help, "caveman help", "what caveman commands", "how do I use caveman".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 敲一行指令，立刻看到全部模式、技能与命令的速查卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你总记不住对话助手有哪些命令和技能可用
copy.tagline_en: Type one command to view a quick-reference card for all modes, skills, and commands.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often forget which commands and skills your assistant offers.

howto.what: 装好后,当被触发时会显示一张caveman模式的速查卡,列出所有模式、技能和命令;只显示一次,不切换模式、不写入任何文件,输出用caveman风格。
howto.when: 当你说“/caveman-help”、“caveman help”等指令,或问“caveman怎么用”时触发;仅显示一次,不成为持续模式。

say.note: Claude会展示模式/技能速查卡。
触发一次性参考展示,不改变模式。
列出可用模式、技能和退出方法。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude displays a quick-reference card of all caveman modes, skills, and commands. One-shot: no mode change, no file writes. Output in caveman style.
howto.when_en: Triggers on '/caveman-help', 'caveman help', 'what caveman commands', etc. Displays once; not a persistent mode.

say_en.note: Claude shows the modes/skills cheat sheet.
Triggers one-shot reference, no mode change.
Lists modes, skills, and how to exit.
